items.briefing:
Australia's financial regulator ASIC is warning that scammers are increasingly using AI-generated deepfakes to run convincing fake investment schemes targeting Australians — be cautious of unsolicited investment opportunities, even if they feature recognisable faces or voices. Separately, a China-linked hacker group has demonstrated advanced AI capabilities in attacks across the Asia-Pacific region, meaning Australian organisations should remain vigilant about targeted intrusions.

OpenAI has also rolled out a teen-specific version of ChatGPT in Australia with added safety features — if you have children using AI tools, it's worth checking which version they're accessing. **Practical tip:** If someone contacts you about an investment opportunity online, independently verify it through ASIC's website before engaging.

featured.title: PCI council marks 20 years with AI focus in Kuala Lumpur
featured.summary: Banks and merchants face fresh fraud risks as the council's Kuala Lumpur meeting weighs how AI is changing payment security.
